situation: Why I picked the cheaper vendor
mightSay: Basically we went with the cheaper vendor only, because the other one was also good but cost was more.
better: I picked the cheaper vendor. Their quality matched, and they cost 20% less.

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: Delivery takes two days longer, which we can live with.

situation: Halfway update on a report
mightSay: So the report is going on, I have done some parts and some parts are remaining, it will get done.
better: The report is half done. I'll send the draft on Thursday.

next.title: Even better

lines.label: Add what's left
lines.text: Sections one to three are done. The charts are next.

next.note: Name the part that is left.

situation: I'm torn between two job offers
mightSay: Both offers are good only, I am very confused, one is giving more money and one is near to home.
better: I'm torn. One offer pays more; the other is ten minutes from home.

next.title: Say what would decide it

lines.label: Decider
lines.text: If the commute is under 40 minutes, I'll take the higher pay.

next.note: Tell them what tips the balance.

situation: Late because the client changed the brief
mightSay: Actually the client changed everything last minute, so that is why it got delayed from our side.
better: The client changed the brief on Monday, so the design moves to next Wednesday.

next.title: Even better

lines.label: Show it's handled
lines.text: We've agreed the new brief with them, so the date will hold.

next.note: Show the new date is safe.

situation: Here's how I see the problem
mightSay: What I feel is, the problem is not the app, people are not knowing how to use it.
better: I don't think the app is the problem. People don't know how to use it.

next.title: Back it up

lines.label: Evidence
lines.text: Most support calls ask where the save button is.

next.note: One fact makes the view stick.

situation: Answering 'what do you do?' at a wedding
mightSay: I am working in an IT company, in the software side, it's like a technical type of job only.
better: I build the apps banks use for loans.

next.title: Second situation

lines.label: At a client meeting
lines.text: I lead the team that builds loan apps for banks.

next.note: Same answer, a little more formal.

situation: Why I said no to the new feature
mightSay: I told no to that feature because it is not making sense now and time is less.
better: I said no for now. We don't have time to build it well.

next.title: Leave the door open

lines.label: Later
lines.text: Let's look at it again after the March release.

next.note: A no for now is not a no forever.

situation: Why I'd wait one more week before launching
mightSay: We should not launch now, we should wait one week or so, things are not fully ready.
better: I'd wait one more week. Payments still fail on some phones.

next.title: Name the cost of rushing

lines.label: Risk
lines.text: If we launch now, angry reviews will follow.

next.note: Show why the wait is worth it.

situation: Update when nothing has changed
mightSay: Regarding the update, there is no update as such, everything is same only as last time.
better: No change since Monday. We're still waiting on the legal review.

next.title: Even better

lines.label: Add when
lines.text: Legal says they'll reply by Friday.

next.note: Give them the next date to watch.

situation: Why I'd hire the second candidate
mightSay: Both are good, but I am feeling the second one is better, she is having more experience.
better: I'd hire the second candidate. She has run this kind of project before.

lines.label: Risk
lines.text: She asked for more pay, so we'd need to stretch the budget.

situation: Late because you were waiting on another team
mightSay: We are not able to finish because the other team has not given their part yet.
better: We're waiting on the data team's numbers. Once they arrive, we need two days.

next.title: Even better

lines.label: Ask for help
lines.text: Could you nudge their lead? It would help us hit Friday.

next.note: Offer a way to unblock it.

situation: Torn between staying late and coming in early
mightSay: Should I sit late today or come early tomorrow, I am not sure what is better.
better: I'll come in early tomorrow. I think better in the morning.

next.title: Say the condition

lines.label: If
lines.text: If the client needs it tonight, I'll stay.

next.note: Show what would change your plan.

situation: Explaining your job to a child
mightSay: I am a data analyst, I analyse the data and make reports for the management to take decisions.
better: I count things for a big company, so they know what to make more of.

lines.label: Example
lines.text: If more people buy blue shoes, I tell them to make more blue shoes.

situation: Why I think the plan is too risky
mightSay: I am not comfortable with this plan, it is too much risky, many things can go wrong.
better: I think the plan is too risky. If one supplier fails, everything stops.

next.title: Offer a safer path

lines.label: Option
lines.text: Could we sign a second supplier as a backup?

next.note: Pair a worry with a way out.

situation: Update with one blocker
mightSay: Everything is going fine, just one small issue is there with the login, rest all is on track.
better: We're on track, with one blocker: login fails for new users.

next.title: Say what you need

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: I need an hour with Ravi to fix it.

next.note: A blocker comes with a request.

situation: Why I changed the order of the slides
mightSay: I have changed the slides order, the price slide I have put before, it will be better.
better: I moved the price slide up. Clients ask about cost first.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: Does that flow work for you?

situation: Delay caused by your own mistake
mightSay: Actually there was some confusion and the file got deleted somehow, so it will take some more time.
better: I deleted the file by mistake. I'm rebuilding it and will send it tomorrow at noon.

lines.label: Prevent it
lines.text: I've set up automatic backups, so it won't happen again.

situation: How I got to this number
mightSay: This number I got by doing some calculations with last year data and all.
better: I took last year's sales and added 10% for the new store. That gives 5,500 units.

next.title: Name the guess

lines.label: Assumption
lines.text: The 10% is a guess based on our last store opening.

next.note: Say which part is an estimate.

situation: Telling a new neighbour what you do
mightSay: I am in a private company only, in the accounts department, doing the accounts work.
better: I'm an accountant. I make sure a hotel chain pays its bills on time.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: What about you? Do you work nearby?

situation: Why I'd test with ten users first
mightSay: Before launching to all, I am thinking we can do one testing with ten users or so.
better: I'd test with ten users first. We'll catch the big problems cheaply.

lines.label: Timing
lines.text: Testing takes a week, so we'd still launch this month.

situation: Why I want to drop one feature
mightSay: I am feeling the chat feature we can remove, nobody is using it much.
better: I'd drop the chat feature. Only 2% of users open it, and it slows every release.

lines.label: Option
lines.text: We can bring it back if users ask for it.

situation: Update after a client call
mightSay: I had the call with client, it went okay, they said some things, I will share details later.
better: The call went well. They approved the design but want a lower price.

lines.label: Next
lines.text: I'll send a revised quote by Wednesday.

situation: Why I chose the train over the flight
mightSay: I booked the train only because flight was costly and also airport is very far from my place.
better: I took the train. It's cheaper, and the station is ten minutes from home.

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: It takes four hours longer, but I can work on board.

situation: Delay because a teammate fell sick
mightSay: One of our team member is not well since two days, so work is getting delayed.
better: Priya has been ill since Tuesday, so testing will finish on Monday, not Friday.

lines.label: Plan
lines.text: Arjun is taking over her part today.

situation: Why I'm not sure yet, and what would decide it
mightSay: Right now I cannot say anything, it depends on many things, let us see what happens.
better: I'm not sure yet. If the client signs by Friday, I'd say go.

lines.label: When
lines.text: I'll have an answer by Friday evening.

situation: Answering at a networking event
mightSay: I am working as a senior consultant in a consulting firm, we do consulting for different clients.
better: I help factories cut waste. Last year we saved one client 15% on materials.
changes: what you do, not your title

lines.label: Turn it
lines.text: What brings you here tonight?

situation: Why I picked this restaurant for the team dinner
mightSay: I selected this place because it is good only, and also it is near.
better: I picked this place because it's close to the office and has good veg options.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: Does anyone have a food allergy I should mention?

situation: Why I'd split the project into two phases
mightSay: This project is very big, so I am thinking we can do it in two parts.
better: I'd split it into two phases: the core in May, extras in July.

lines.label: Why
lines.text: We get feedback early instead of guessing for six months.

situation: Weekly update in stand-up
mightSay: Yesterday I was doing the testing and all, today also I will do the same, no issues as such.
better: Yesterday I tested checkout. Today I'll test refunds. No blockers.

lines.label: Add a result
lines.text: Checkout passed, except for one bug in coupons.

situation: Explaining a hunch you can't fully prove
mightSay: I cannot prove it, but I am having a feeling that customers are not liking the new price.
better: I can't prove it yet, but I think the new price is putting people off.

next.title: Say how to check

lines.label: Test
lines.text: We could ask ten customers this week.

next.note: Turn the hunch into a test.

situation: Late reply to a friend's message
mightSay: Sorry sorry, I was very busy, I saw your message but I could not reply, you know how it is.
better: Sorry for the slow reply! Work has been crazy this week.

lines.label: Reply
lines.text: Yes, Saturday works. Where should we meet?

situation: Why I'd rather call than email this client
mightSay: Instead of mailing, better I will call them, on mail they are not replying properly.
better: I'd rather call this client. They ignore long emails, but they pick up the phone.

next.title: Close the loop

lines.label: After
lines.text: I'll send a short email after the call, so it's on record.

next.note: Calls still need a written trail.

situation: Describing your role in a job interview
mightSay: In my current company I am handling many things, like client, team, reports, everything I am doing.
better: I lead a team of five and manage our three biggest clients.

lines.label: Result
lines.text: Last year we kept all three clients and grew them by 20%.

situation: Why I'm saying yes, with one condition
mightSay: Okay I will do it, but only thing is that I need some help, otherwise it will be difficult.
better: Yes, I'll do it, as long as I get one more person for testing.

next.title: Say why

lines.label: Reason
lines.text: Testing alone would take me three weeks.

next.note: The reason makes the condition fair.

situation: What I'd need to see to change my mind
mightSay: I am not agreeing now, but maybe if something is there then I can think again.
better: I'd change my mind if the pilot shows sales going up.

next.title: Set a bar

lines.label: Number
lines.text: Say, 10% more sales in the first month.

next.note: A clear bar keeps it fair.

situation: Update that you finished early
mightSay: The work which you gave is completed already, I finished it before itself.
better: The deck is done, two days early. It's in the shared folder.

lines.label: Next
lines.text: Want me to start on the speaker notes?

situation: Why I'd keep the old design for now
mightSay: The new design is nice, but for now we keep the old one only.
better: I'd keep the old design for now. Users know it, and we're mid-sale.

lines.label: When
lines.text: Let's switch after the sale ends.

situation: Delivery stuck at customs
mightSay: The shipment is stuck at customs and they are not clearing it, so we don't know when it will come.
better: The shipment is held at customs. Our agent expects it cleared by Thursday.

lines.label: Backup
lines.text: If it slips again, we can send 50 units from the Pune store.

situation: Why I think the delay is worth it
mightSay: I know it is getting late, but it is okay only, the result will be much better.
better: The delay is worth it. Two more weeks means the app works offline.

lines.label: Cost
lines.text: We'll miss the trade show, but we won't demo a broken app.

situation: Explaining your job to your grandmother
mightSay: I am working in digital marketing, we do SEO, social media, campaigns, all that.
better: When you see an ad on your phone, I'm one of the people who made it.

lines.label: Example
lines.text: Last month I made the ads for a new biscuit.

situation: Why I want a second opinion
mightSay: I am not hundred percent sure on this, so better we take one more opinion from somebody.
better: I'd like a second opinion. This contract has terms I haven't seen before.

lines.label: Who
lines.text: Could Meera from legal look at it by Wednesday?

situation: Update on a bug fix
mightSay: The bug is fixed mostly, some testing is pending, it should be okay I think.
better: The fix is in. We're testing it now and will release by 5.

lines.label: Who's affected
lines.text: Until then, users can still pay by card.

situation: Why I'm worried about the timeline
mightSay: I am little bit tense about the dates, it is very tight, how we will manage.
better: I'm worried about the timeline. We have six weeks of work and four weeks left.

lines.label: Option
lines.text: We could cut the reports page and add it in June.

situation: Late to a meeting because of traffic
mightSay: So sorry, there was too much traffic, the road was totally jammed, I left early only but still.
better: Sorry I'm late, the traffic was bad. Please carry on, I'll catch up.

next.title: Second situation

lines.label: Before the meeting
lines.text: Running ten minutes late. Please start without me.

next.note: A heads-up beats a long sorry.

situation: Why I'd ask the client before deciding
mightSay: We can decide ourselves also, but better we ask the client once, otherwise problem may come.
better: Let's check with the client first. They may want to keep the old logo.

next.title: Keep it quick

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: I'll message them today and share their answer tomorrow.

next.note: Show it won't slow things down.

situation: Why I'd pay more for faster delivery
mightSay: It is costing more, but I think we should take the fast delivery, because otherwise it will come late.
better: I'd pay the extra 3,000 for fast delivery. Otherwise the parts miss the launch.

next.title: Compare

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: A late launch would cost far more than 3,000.

next.note: Put the cost next to the risk.

situation: When your job title confuses people
mightSay: My designation is solutions architect, it is little bit technical, you will not understand.
better: I'm a solutions architect. I plan how a company's software fits together.

lines.label: Example
lines.text: When a bank adds a new app, I make sure it talks to the old ones.

situation: Why I'd rent before buying a flat
mightSay: Buying is good, but first we should take on rent and see, we are new to the city.
better: I'd rent for a year first. We don't know the city well yet.

lines.label: Benefit
lines.text: By then we'll know which area suits us.

situation: Update with good and bad news
mightSay: There is one good news and one bad news, client has signed, but they are wanting it earlier.
better: Good news: the client signed. Bad news: they want it two weeks sooner.

lines.label: Plan
lines.text: I'm checking with the team if we can meet the new date.

situation: Why I'd move the meeting to the morning
mightSay: We can shift the meeting to morning, evening time people are tired and not focusing.
better: Can we move the meeting to 10 a.m.? People are sharper in the morning.

lines.label: Also
lines.text: The Singapore team can join before they log off.

situation: Delay because testing found bugs
mightSay: During testing many bugs came, so release is getting delayed, we are working on it.
better: Testing found five serious bugs, so the release moves to Tuesday.

lines.label: Point
lines.text: It's better we find them than our customers do.

situation: What I'm sure of and what I'm guessing
mightSay: Some things I know, some things I am not knowing, so overall it may be like this.
better: I'm sure sales dropped in June. I'm guessing the price rise caused it.

next.title: Say how to check

lines.label: Check
lines.text: We can compare with the stores that kept the old price.

next.note: Show how you'd test the guess.

situation: The one reason that decided it for me
mightSay: There are many reasons, like price, location, people, many things, so finally I decided.
better: It came down to one thing: the team. I liked the people I'd work with.

lines.label: Also
lines.text: The pay and location were fine, but they didn't decide it.

situation: When you're between jobs
mightSay: Right now I am not working anywhere, I left my last job, I am searching only.
better: I'm between jobs. I left a bank in May, and I'm looking at fintech roles.

lines.label: Detail
lines.text: I'm also doing a short course in data analysis.

situation: Why I'd start small
mightSay: Instead of doing everything at once, I am thinking we should start with something small and then see.
better: I'd start with one product line. If it sells, we add the rest.

lines.label: Why
lines.text: We learn what works without betting the whole budget.

situation: Update to a boss who missed the meeting
mightSay: In the meeting many things were discussed, I will tell you in detail when you are free.
better: Quick summary: we approved the budget and moved the launch to June 10.

lines.label: For you
lines.text: They need your sign-off on the hiring plan by Friday.

situation: Why I didn't follow the usual process
mightSay: I know process is there, but this time I did it directly, because there was urgency.
better: I skipped the usual sign-off because the client needed it within an hour.

lines.label: Follow-up
lines.text: I've sent it for sign-off now, after the fact.

situation: Late payment to a vendor
mightSay: Payment is in process, from accounts side it is pending, it will come soon.
better: Your payment is late because our finance team was short-staffed. It goes out on Friday.

lines.label: Sorry
lines.text: Sorry for the wait, and thanks for your patience.

situation: Why I think we're solving the wrong problem
mightSay: We are all working on speed, but the actual problem is something else only.
better: I think we're solving the wrong problem. Users leave at sign-up, not over speed.

lines.label: Evidence
lines.text: Half of new users quit on the sign-up page.

situation: Update on a hiring search
mightSay: Hiring is going on, we have seen many profiles, some are good, let us see.
better: We've interviewed eight people. Two are strong, and we'll pick by Friday.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: Could you meet the final two on Thursday?

situation: Why I'd hold off on hiring
mightSay: We should not hire now, I think we should wait some time, because things are not clear.
better: I'd hold off hiring until March. We don't know yet if the big contract will renew.

lines.label: Meanwhile
lines.text: We could use a freelancer for the next two months.

situation: When you run your own business
mightSay: I have my own business, it is a small business only, nothing big.
better: I run a bakery in Indiranagar. We supply cakes to five cafés.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: Do you have a favourite café nearby?

situation: Weighing speed against quality
mightSay: If we do fast, quality will suffer, if we do quality, it will take time.
better: We can have it fast or polished, not both. I'd go polished, since clients will see it.

next.title: Give the cost

lines.label: Cost
lines.text: Polished means one extra week.

next.note: Put a number on the choice.

situation: Weighing cost against comfort
mightSay: The cheaper hotel is okay but very small, the other one is nice but costly, I am confused.
better: The cheaper hotel saves 4,000, but the rooms are tiny. For three nights, I'd pay more.

lines.label: Decider
lines.text: If it were one night, I'd take the cheap one.

situation: Report delayed by missing data
mightSay: The report is not done because data is not there, once data comes I will do it.
better: The report is waiting on March sales data. I'll finish it a day after it arrives.

next.title: Ask for help

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: Could you ask finance to send it by Wednesday?

next.note: Tell them how to speed it up.

situation: Why I'd ask for more data
mightSay: With this much data we cannot decide properly, I think we need some more data also.
better: I'd wait for more data. Two weeks of sales is too little to judge.

lines.label: When
lines.text: Four more weeks should be enough.

situation: Update to family on a home repair
mightSay: The plumber came and he did something, he said some part is needed, he will come again.
better: The plumber fixed the leak for now. He's back on Saturday to replace the pipe.

lines.label: Cost
lines.text: The new pipe will cost about 2,000.

situation: Why I agree, but only partly
mightSay: Yes, I am agreeing with you, but not fully, on some points I am having a different view.
better: I agree on the price. I'm less sure about the launch date.

next.title: Explain the doubt

lines.label: Why
lines.text: Two weeks leaves no time to train the sales team.

next.note: Be specific about the part you doubt.

situation: Your job in one line on a video call
mightSay: Hi, I am Rahul, I am from the tech team, I am working on the backend side and other things.
better: Hi, I'm Rahul. I keep the payment system running.
changes: what you do, not your team

lines.label: Context
lines.text: I'm here to answer questions about refunds.

situation: Why I'd say no to the discount
mightSay: Discount we should not give, because if we give once then every time they will ask.
better: I'd say no to the discount. If we give it once, they'll expect it every time.

next.title: Offer something instead

lines.label: Instead
lines.text: We could offer free delivery on this order.

next.note: A no lands softer with an option.

situation: Why I want to automate this task
mightSay: Every week we are doing this manually, it is taking lot of time, so better we automate it.
better: I'd like to automate the weekly report. It takes Anil six hours by hand.

lines.label: Payoff
lines.text: The script takes two days to build and saves 300 hours a year.

situation: Late because the approval took long
mightSay: Approval was pending from management side, it took lot of time, so we got delayed.
better: The approval took two weeks instead of two days, so we start on the 15th.

lines.label: Next time
lines.text: For the next phase, I'll ask for approval a week early.

situation: Why I'd give the new joiner this task
mightSay: This task I am thinking we can give to the new joiner, it will be good for her.
better: I'd give this task to Neha. It's small, and she'll learn our tools fast.

lines.label: Support
lines.text: I'll check in with her on day two.

situation: Update on a late shipment
mightSay: The shipment has not come yet, we are following up, they are saying it will come.
better: The shipment is two days late. The courier says Thursday morning.

lines.label: Plan
lines.text: If it's not here by noon Thursday, I'll call their manager.

situation: Why I'd pick the simpler tool
mightSay: The other tool is having many features, but I feel this simple one is better for us only.
better: I'd pick the simpler tool. We need three features, and it has all three.

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: We lose advanced reports, which nobody asked for.

situation: When they ask what your company makes
mightSay: We are a manufacturing company, we make different types of products for industries.
better: We make the plastic caps on shampoo bottles.

lines.label: Size
lines.text: About a million a day, for brands you'd know.

situation: Why I'd cut the meeting to thirty minutes
mightSay: One hour meeting is too much, mostly we are just talking only.
better: I'd cut this meeting to 30 minutes. We decide everything in the first half.

next.title: Make it work

lines.label: How
lines.text: If we share updates in writing first, 30 minutes is enough.

next.note: Say how it will still work.

situation: Delay in a home renovation, told to family
mightSay: The kitchen work is still going on, the workers are not coming properly, it will take time.
better: The kitchen will take two more weeks. The tiles arrived late.

lines.label: Meanwhile
lines.text: We can cook on the small stove on the balcony until then.

situation: Why I'd launch in one city first
mightSay: Instead of all-India launch, I am suggesting we go with one city first and see.
better: I'd launch in Pune first. It's big enough to learn from and cheap to fix.

next.title: Say what's next

lines.label: Then
lines.text: If it works for two months, we add Mumbai and Delhi.

next.note: Show the path to the rest.

situation: Update when the plan changed
mightSay: There is some change in the plan, now we are doing it differently, I will explain.
better: Change of plan: we're launching on the web first, and the app comes in August.

next.title: Say why

lines.label: Reason
lines.text: App store review takes too long for our date.

next.note: People accept change with a reason.

situation: Why I think the numbers look off
mightSay: These numbers are looking little bit wrong to me, something is not matching somewhere.
better: I think these numbers are off. Sales went up, but the total went down.

next.title: Suggest a check

lines.label: Check
lines.text: Could we look at the March refunds?

next.note: Point to where the error might be.

situation: Why I'd keep a client who pays late
mightSay: He pays late always, I know, but still I am thinking we should not lose him.
better: I'd keep this client. They pay late, but they're 30% of our revenue.

next.title: Add a condition

lines.label: Fix
lines.text: Let's ask for half the fee upfront.

next.note: Keep the client, fix the problem.

situation: When you've just switched careers
mightSay: Earlier I was in banking, now I have changed my line, now I am doing UX design.
better: I design apps now. Before that, I spent eight years in banking.

lines.label: Link
lines.text: So I design a lot of banking apps.

situation: Thinking out loud before deciding
mightSay: Let me think... so if we do this, then that will happen, then... I don't know, it's confusing.
better: Let me think out loud. If we hire now, we spend more but finish by June.

lines.label: Other side
lines.text: If we wait, we save money but finish in August.

situation: Delay because the work grew
mightSay: Work is increasing day by day, new requirements are coming, so time is also increasing.
better: The work has grown from 10 screens to 18, so we need three more weeks.

next.title: Offer a choice

lines.label: Choice
lines.text: Or we keep the date and leave out the extra screens.

next.note: Let them choose scope or time.

situation: Giving two options and your pick

better: Two options: hire now or use a freelancer. I'd use a freelancer for three months.

lines.label: Why
lines.text: It's cheaper, and we're not sure the work will last.

situation: One-line update on chat
mightSay: Hi, good morning, hope you are doing well, just wanted to update that the work is going on.
better: Morning! The draft is 80% done. Sending it by 3.

next.title: If there's a problem

lines.text: The draft is 80% done, but I need the logo file to finish.

next.note: Put the ask in the same message.

situation: Why I'd skip the family trip this year
mightSay: This time I am thinking I will not come for the trip, there are some things going on.
better: I'll skip the trip this year. I have exams the same week.

lines.label: Offer
lines.text: Can we do a dinner when you're back?

situation: Why I'd pick the flat closer to work
mightSay: The other flat is bigger but this one is near office, so travelling will be less only.
better: I'd take the flat near work. It saves me two hours a day.

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: It's smaller, but I'd rather have the time.

situation: Answering at a school reunion
mightSay: Nothing much, same old, I am working in a company, life is going on.
better: I'm a teacher now. I teach maths at a school in Chennai.

next.title: Ask back

lines.label: Turn it
lines.text: What about you? Still painting?

next.note: Reunions are for catching up both ways.

situation: Why I'd wait for the sale
mightSay: Buying now is not good I think, sale is coming next month, we can wait.
better: I'd wait for the sale. It starts in two weeks, and the price drops by a third.

lines.label: Unless
lines.text: If the old one breaks first, buy it now.

situation: Late for dinner with friends
mightSay: Guys I am on the way, just five minutes, coming, coming, don't worry.
better: Running 20 minutes late. Please order without me!

lines.label: Add your order
lines.text: Running 20 minutes late. Order me the pasta, please!

situation: Why I trust this supplier
mightSay: This supplier is very good, I am trusting him fully, he never gives any problem.
better: I trust this supplier. In three years, they've never missed a date.

lines.label: Still
lines.text: I'd still check the first batch of the new product.

situation: Update on the budget
mightSay: Budget-wise we are okay mostly, some extra expenses came but it is manageable.
better: We're 5% over budget, mainly from travel. We'll still finish under the limit.

next.title: Add the fix

lines.label: Plan
lines.text: We're moving the last two visits to video calls.

next.note: Show how you'll stay on track.

situation: Why I'd rather fix it than replace it
mightSay: Replacing is costly, I feel we can repair and use only, it is still working mostly.
better: I'd fix it. The repair costs 2,000; a new one costs 15,000.

lines.label: Limit
lines.text: If it breaks again this year, we replace it.

situation: Why I'd say sorry first
mightSay: Even though it is not fully our mistake, I am thinking we should say sorry to them first.
better: Let's apologise first, even if it's only partly our fault. It will calm things down.

lines.label: After
lines.text: Once they're calm, we can explain what happened.

situation: Explaining your job to someone in a very different field
mightSay: I am in cybersecurity, we do threat detection, vulnerability management, all these things.
better: I protect a company's computers from hackers. I find the weak spots before they do.

lines.label: Example
lines.text: Last week I stopped a fake email that looked like it came from our boss.

situation: Why I'd ask the team before promising a date
mightSay: Date I cannot give now, first team I have to ask, then only I can say.
better: Let me check with the team first. I'll give you a date by 4.

lines.label: Reason
lines.text: I'd rather give you a date we'll actually hit.

situation: Delay because of a public holiday
mightSay: Due to holiday, the office is closed, so the work will happen after the holiday only.
better: The bank is closed on Monday for the holiday, so the transfer goes through on Tuesday.

lines.label: Next time
lines.text: I'll send payments before long weekends.

situation: Update after testing
mightSay: Testing is done, mostly everything is working, few small things are there.
better: Testing is done. 47 of 50 checks passed, and the 3 failures are small.

lines.label: Next
lines.text: We'll fix them tomorrow and release on Friday.

situation: Why I'd spend the bonus on a course
mightSay: I am thinking to do one course with the bonus, it will help in career.
better: I'm spending my bonus on a data course. It could get me a promotion next year.

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: The holiday can wait a year.

situation: Here's my reasoning in three steps
mightSay: So there are many points, first this, then also that, and then one more thing is there.
better: I'd pick Tool B for three reasons: it's cheaper, it's faster, and the team knows it.

lines.label: Ask
lines.text: Does that match what you've seen?

situation: When you work behind the scenes
mightSay: My work is not visible to customers, it is all backend side, hard to explain.
better: You won't see my work, but you'd notice if it broke. I keep the app's servers running.

lines.label: Example
lines.text: When the app opens in a second, that's my team.

situation: Admitting what you don't know yet
mightSay: That thing I am not knowing exactly, I will check and tell you.
better: I don't know yet. I'll find out and reply by noon tomorrow.

lines.label: Partly
lines.text: I know the price; I'm not sure about delivery yet.

situation: A second delay on the same task
mightSay: Again it is getting delayed, I know, sorry, some more issues came.
better: I'm sorry, this is the second delay. The new date is the 20th, and I'm confident in it.
changes: why to trust the new date

lines.label: Proof
lines.text: The last open item is done; only checks are left.

situation: Why I'd take the call myself
mightSay: This call I will only take, because it is sensitive and I know the full background.
better: I'll take this call myself. The client is upset, and I know the history.

lines.label: After
lines.text: I'll share notes with the team afterwards.

situation: Update on a customer complaint
mightSay: Regarding the complaint, we are looking into it, the team is checking.
better: We found the cause: a billing error. Refunds go out today.

next.title: Add what changes

lines.label: Prevention
lines.text: We've added a check, so it won't happen again.

next.note: Customers want it fixed for good.

situation: Why I'd stop the project now
mightSay: This project is not going anywhere, I feel we should stop it before more money goes.
better: I'd stop the project now. After six months, only 50 people use it.

lines.label: Keep
lines.text: The search code can go into the main app.

situation: Why I'd keep things as they are
mightSay: I don't think any change is required, it is working fine only, why to change.
better: I'd keep things as they are. The current setup works, and changing it costs a month.

lines.label: Unless
lines.text: If complaints double, I'd look again.

situation: When they ask 'is that a good job?'
mightSay: It is okay only, salary is fine, nothing so great.
better: I like it. The work is interesting, and I'm learning a lot.

lines.label: If you don't like it
lines.text: It pays well, but I'm looking for something more creative.

situation: Explaining a gut call to your manager
mightSay: I don't have data for this, it is just my feeling, but we should go with it.
better: This is a gut call. The client sounded unsure, so I'd send a smaller proposal.
changes: name it as a gut call

next.title: Offer a check

lines.label: Check
lines.text: I can ask them one question tomorrow to confirm.

next.note: Gut calls earn trust with a check.

situation: Delay because your laptop crashed
mightSay: My laptop got crashed suddenly, all the work was in that, so I need some time.
better: My laptop crashed, and I lost today's work. I'll redo it and send it by 11 tomorrow.

lines.label: Fix
lines.text: I've moved everything to the cloud, so this won't happen again.

situation: Why I'd do the risky part first
mightSay: The difficult part we should do first only, otherwise at the end it will create problem.
better: Let's do the risky part first. If it fails, we find out early.

lines.label: Payoff
lines.text: After that, the rest of the project is safe ground.

situation: Update before going on leave
mightSay: I am going on leave from tomorrow, everything is mostly done, if anything is there you can call.
better: I'm off from tomorrow until the 12th. The report is done; Kiran covers client calls.

next.title: Add where

lines.label: Where
lines.text: All the files are in the shared folder, under April.

next.note: Make sure no one needs to call you.

situation: Why I'd work from the office on Mondays
mightSay: Mondays I can come to office, because that day only all the planning is happening.
better: I'd like to work from the office on Mondays. That's when we plan the week.

lines.label: Benefit
lines.text: I can sort out questions face to face, not over chat.
